messages:
eric: Heads-up: we rolled a 2% canary for the microcache-prefetch + tiny-batcher change. Goal: cut token compute and unclog coalescer on short-turn chats.
nisha: Replayed 24h prod mix. Quick numbers: p50 -11%, p95 -9%, p99 -16%. Token cost estimate down ~7.5%. Biggest wins on routes with seq <= 40.
infra-bot: Canary artifact: https://internal.redwood/bench/2765432109
```
shard-mean:
- p50: 25ms -> 22.3ms
- p95: 130ms -> 118.3ms
- p99: 410ms -> 344.4ms
- cost/1k tokens: $0.074 -> $0.068
- 5xx rate: 0.08% -> 0.085% (no signal)
```
olga: Any memory or queue tail concerns?
nisha: No sustained CUDA mem delta. We did see one short spike in coalescer queue on shard-7 during ramp (~40s) but it cleared and didn't trigger fallbacks. We placed temporary pin for seq>64 to stable kernel.
eric: Canary policy used: pct=2, ramp 2->25->100 over 120m, eval window 10m. Rollback if p99 rel increase >12% or error rate increase >0.5% or sustained gpu_mem_growth_mb >45.
product: Can we get a one-line customer-facing blurb for the weekly?
olga: Draft: "Runtime tuning reduced median response time by ~11% and p99 by ~16% for short multi-turn chats, lowering token cost by ~7.5%."
eric: I uploaded a seq-length heatmap and a short note on fallback logic to the artifact. We'll watch the dashboards (runtime.coalesce.*, runtime.kv_prefetch.*) and PagerDuty for 90m. If green we ramp to 25% then full. 
nisha: Thanks team 680
